source_refs.note: Responses to Overheating (Hyperthermia): a main subheading of 13.3.3 Thermoregulation in Humans, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 8-8.

blocks.text: Jab jism ka darja-e-hararat 37°C se barh jata hai to vasodilation hota hai: jild ki epidermis ke bilkul neeche wali khoon ki capillaries phail jati hain. Is liye in capillaries mein zyada khoon behta hai aur khoon ki zyada hararat jild se bahar nikal jati hai. Jawab mein paseena (sweating) bhi shamil hai. Paseena bhap ban kar urta hai (evaporation) to jism ki hararat saath le jata hai aur thandak paida karta hai. Thyroid gland thyroxine hormone ka ikhraj kam kar sakta hai, jis se basal metabolic rate (aaram ki halat mein metabolism ki raftar) kam hoti hai aur jism ke andar hararat kam banti hai.

blocks.title: Hum garmi ya thand kaise mehsoos karte hain
blocks.text: Thermoreceptors dimagh ke upar wale markazon (higher centres) ko bhi signal dete hain. Is liye hum garmi ya thand ko 'mehsoos' karte hain. Is se hum mazeed qadam utha sakte hain, maslan nahana, ya pankha ya heater chalana.
